title: A lane session's merge commit that resolves both test and product files is refused
why: Coordinator 12:02 CST Nov 8: refuse a merge commit made by a lane session (not a test-author) whose resolution touches both test and product files. Builds on #1521's role reader, so it starts once #1521 merges. Sightings: 1a444eb96 on #1932, and #2194's #1479 merge (11:59 CST). Owner item 437 (builder-test-edit-scope) is open on the same guard.
note: #1521 is on main (batch 69, 624dcc188), so this step may start. Sighting 3, folded from the coordinator's orchestrator-resolves-merge (15:52 CST Nov 9): lane record-tool-posts-itself (#2413, merge 6e127172a, 15:31 CST) resolved three conflict hunks itself, in a decision doc, merge.py and test_merge.py, with no role agent and no refusal. The coordinator's proposed check: refuse a lane or coordinator session's own Edit or Write to a product or test file while MERGE_HEAD is set, as well as the merge commit.
